Run 78387 failed implicit-width elaboration; its repaired FIRST adds (bits := bits), while its proof and three motives stay exact. All sources, failures and repairs remain reproducible. All five owned temporary namespaces are removed: 254,458,576 regular bytes and 31,595 links. Cumulative verified removal is 6,874,564,437 bytes. Structural Seeds do not prove native inhabitance, guard truth or ONE finite accepted completion of the SAME original root under ONE compatible assignment satisfying ALL current and removed/parked historical obligations on the SAME branch. Retain all original roots, stops, fuels, budgets and earlier outputs, plus typing, adequacy, completeness, preprocessing/LPO, order, multiplicity, lazy demand, counts, weights/training, rank inverses, host bounds and compiled Haskell correspondence.
